fusions.name: Downpour
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage and leaving the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Thunderhead Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 11 damage to the first enemy it meets, leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds and spreads your afflictions on it to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Grey Curtain
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Fresh After Falling
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you restore 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
